rv.q: Ruined by Pulitzer-winning playwright Lynn Nottage is a visceral and gripping drama that puts the hidden horrors of war on display.
If you’re going to see a play right now, make it this one.
And yet their words, and the power of the acting in this Invictus show, delivers the story viscerally, bringing this reviewer to tears, to cry out in woe, to bury my head in my arms
None of this minutia diminishes from the power of the play and this production, which is devastating.
There is a powerful scene in Act two where we see just how strong an actress Ms Gardner is. You need to see it for yourself, but she is terrific.
Overall, Ruined was a good production.

cn.t: Critics praise Invictus Theatre's visceral, gripping production of Nottage's Pulitzer-winning drama, highlighting exceptional performances that powerfully expose the horrors of war and sexual violence in the Congo, though the difficult subject matter makes for challenging viewing
